questions.scenario: A new student is introducing himself to the class.
questions.question:
Teacher: Welcome to the class. How old are you?
Student: ___________________
questions.explanation: 問句 How old are you? 詢問年齡。回答必須包含數字 (nine)。選項 A 的 fine 是回答 How are you?；選項 C 的 tall 為形容詞不符合語境。
questions.commonMisconception: 常把 How old are you? (你幾歲) 與 How are you? (你好嗎) 混淆，而反射性地回答 I am fine.

questions.scenario: Two friends are talking about a little sister's birthday party.
questions.question:
Boy: It's Lily's birthday today.
Girl: Wow! ___________________
Boy: She is seven.
questions.explanation: 根據回答 She is seven. (她七歲) 逆向推斷出問句必須是詢問年紀 How old is she?。選項 B 問狀況，選項 C 問是誰，均不符合回答。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒注意上下文中的數字，任意選擇其它疑問詞；或是分不清 How old 與 How 的差別。

questions.scenario: A family is celebrating grandpa's birthday.
questions.question:
Grandson: Happy birthday, Grandpa! ___________________
Grandpa: I am seventy years old.
questions.explanation: 對爺爺說話是第二人稱，故用 How old are you?。爺爺回答 I am...。選項 B 誤用第三人稱 he；選項 C (你好嗎) 與回答的年紀不搭。
questions.commonMisconception: 對著別人說話時忘記對方是 you，或者錯將詢問年資和詢問健康的問句混淆。

questions.scenario: Two boys are watching a very big dog playing in the park.
questions.question:
Boy A: Look at the big dog! How old is it?
Boy B: ___________________
questions.explanation: 問句主詞是 it (單隻未擬人的狗)，且搭配的 Be 動詞是 is。因此回答需對稱為 It is...。選項 B 在沒有前提下隨意轉換為擬人稱 he；選項 C 錯搭 are；選項 D 誤用複數 They。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒有看清問句的主詞 it，或者動詞單複數對配錯誤 (It are)。

questions.scenario: A girl is drawing a picture of her younger brother and sister.
questions.question:
Dad: They look cute! How old are they?
Girl: ___________________
questions.explanation: 問句主詞為 they (指畫裡面的弟弟和妹妹)，回答時維持第三人稱複數 They are。選項 B 的 we (包含自己) 邏輯錯誤；選項 C 錯用單數 it。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法把複數 they 對應回答句的 they，常被中文『我們』混淆 (覺得是一家人就用 we)。

questions.scenario: Teacher is pointing at a picture of identical twins in a storybook.
questions.question:
Teacher: The brothers look the same. ___________________
Student: They are eight years old.
questions.explanation: 由於雙胞胎是兩個人，且回答是 They are eight...，所以問句必定是複數的 How old are they?。選項 B 單數不符；選項 C 問狀況，不問年紀。
questions.commonMisconception: 看到『兄弟』(brothers) 單字，卻因為習慣而選擇單數的 How old is he。

questions.scenario: A little boy brings his favorite old toy to show and tell.
questions.question:
Boy: This is my oldest car.
Friend: Wow! ___________________
Boy: It's ten years old!
questions.explanation: 詢問一個玩具車(單數)的年紀，需用 How old + is + it?。選項 B (怎麼了/好嗎) 不符語意；選項 C, D 為嚴重的動詞對應錯誤 (are it / am it)。
questions.commonMisconception: 把詢問年紀的 How old 忘記，只記得 How；或是 Be 動詞搭配亂套。

questions.scenario: At a family reunion, aunt is looking at the baby girl.
questions.question:
Aunt: The baby is so small. How old is she?
Mom: ___________________
questions.explanation: 問句為 How old is she? (嬰兒女孩)，回答須對稱使用 She is。選項 B 錯用男性的 He；選項 D 錯搭 are 動詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 面對性別明確的代名詞 (she)，在回答時卻粗心地混淆為 he 或 it。

questions.scenario: Two kids are talking about their pets at home.
questions.question:
Kid A: My dog is six years old. ___________________
Kid B: It is only two years old. It's still a baby.
questions.explanation: 講完自己狗的年紀後，順勢問對方的狗的年紀。對方也以狗 (It is) 來回答年紀。因此問句是 How old is your dog?。選項 B 問對方的年紀不合語境；選項 C 問狀況。
questions.commonMisconception: 讀到對話直接慣性填入 How old are you?，沒意識到交際焦點已經轉移到對方的寵物上。

questions.scenario: A nurse is asking a sick boy and his mom at the clinic.
questions.question:
Nurse: I need to write down the age. _______________
Mom: Oh, he is eight.
questions.explanation: 護理師說要寫下年紀，而且媽媽回答 he is eight，可見問句是問這個男孩的年紀，The boy 是單數，搭配 is，故為 How old is the boy?。選項 C 錯搭 are；選項 D 語意錯誤 (這男孩是什麼)。
questions.commonMisconception: 詢問第三人稱身分時，因為 the boy 名詞被當作複數而錯配 are，或是在疑問詞選擇上出錯。
